name: memanto
description: Persistent semantic memory for AI agents. Remember facts, preferences and decisions, and recall them across sessions.
long_description: Memanto gives your AI assistant long-term memory. It saves typed memories (facts, preferences, decisions, goals, instructions and more) to a Moorcheh memory space and recalls them by meaning in later chats, so you don't have to repeat yourself. Needs a Moorcheh API key (free tier available at https://console.moorcheh.ai/api-keys).

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save a new fact, preference, decision, goal or instruction to memory.

tools.name: batch_remember
tools.description: Save up to 100 memories in one call.

tools.name: recall_recent
tools.description: Get the newest memories, no query needed.

tools.name: recall_as_of
tools.description: Recall what was known at a point in time.

tools.name: recall_changed_since
tools.description: Recall what changed since a given time.

tools.name: answer
tools.description: Answer a question grounded in the agent's memories.

agent_id.title: Agent ID
agent_id.description: Name of the memory space to use. Agents that share an ID share memory.
